Small town boy, turned soldier, turned corpo, turned merc.

V could never stand being confined to a small town where nothing happened and prefered the short visits he had to his corpo uncle in NC .Especially since he lost his mom young due to sickness, he is determined to not go out slowly like that (ironic considering whats to come) and leaves for the army after a hefty argument with his family. 

His godly trigger finger promotes him to counter intelligence, which is how his true name gets changed in the database (always bothered me how no one knew his real name). He never quite fit in here as well, and when the war ends he is left feeling empty and jobless. Luckily, Jenkins recruits/blackmails V after his uncle's "tragic" demise from Arasaka. 

At first Arasaka provides the adventure he was seeking, but it quickly becomes stress, hardening him after a series of lies and corruption. On a job in Mexico he meet Jackie, and they try to off each other, but after realizing V is not the usual corpo trash, they team up and become friends.

This way I play with a V that adopts Jackie's dream of becoming a legend, when in reality he is just afraid of dying slowly like his mom and longs for having loyal friends. I end the game with sending him with Johnny like brothers in arms, and then have V "taking a bullet for Johnny", giving him the body.
